descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S23 axe on All Residents with toggles, Today's Visits, the scan sheet, Add Resident and the dashboard

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 1; TFA-92587 How it works 1)
  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 4; TFA-92587 How it works 4)
  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U6 'In Today' drives the dashboard counts: the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts only the residents marked In Today. (The dashboard tabs and whether the counts follow the tab are TC-20 U3, gated on … (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 How it works 6; TFA-92598 AC 4 (same rule))

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture, Nursing Home

When Run axe on /snf (Today's Visits and the All Residents tab), the resident-list scan sheet (empty and with mocked results), the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet, /snf/add and /snf/dashboard

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Each toggle has an accessible name that identifies its resident and exposes its on/off state

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core: zero serious or critical violations (visual-checks.ts). Expected findings to look for: nested-interactive (the toggle button inside the card's role=button) and toggles all named '+ Today' / 'In Today ✓' with no resident name

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 ready for qa

A screen-reader user hears a row of identical '+ Today' buttons with no resident name and no on/off state. The scan and duplicate sheets have an unnamed close button, and text contrast fails on every screen.

Evidence: allure cb520904, visual lane: 0 of 27 judged checks passed across desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. The toggle sits inside the card's role=button (nested-interactive) and has no aria-pressed. TC-09 risks predicted this, and the S23 oracle names it.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
